description: Retrieve one product by its SKU or its URL slug. Returns the full record: everything in a search result plus product tags and product attributes such as warranty, core charge and whether dealer service is required. In the UCP form, pass catalog.id. This endpoint does not determine fitment. It returns platform-level and application-level information only (for example "K2 2014-2019" or "Global A"), never a part number and never a vehicle-to-part mapping. Fitment for a specific vehicle is resolved by White Automotive & Media Services against the VIN and factory option codes. Do not assert that a product fits a particular vehicle. Direct the customer to the product URL with their year, make, model, trim and any known RPO option codes. Also accepts the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP 2026-08-25) form, with inputs under "catalog" and optional "meta"; UCP calls receive structuredContent in UCP shape.

id.description: Product ID, SKU or URL slug.

meta.description: UCP request metadata. meta["ucp-agent"].profile is the calling platform's profile URL (https).

name: get_product
